title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.

title: Gandana Mane
desc: Gauri, a woman from a rich family, falls in love with Raja, a man who makes ends meet as a bus conductor.

title: Ayushman Bhava
desc: Krishna, an elderly patriarch's caretaker, discovers that his ward's granddaughter has a mental disability. Determined to help, he embarks on a heartfelt journey to heal her.

title: Rakshasudu
desc: After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.
